info.title: Google Drive API — Files (list & get)
info.description: Subset of the Google Drive API v3, converted from the Google API Discovery document. Includes only the `files.list` and `files.get` operations, plus the schemas they reference.

get.description: Lists the user's files. Accepts the `q` parameter, a search query combining one or more search terms. Returns *all* files by default, including trashed files. Use `trashed=false` in `q` to exclude trashed files.

parameters.name: corpora
parameters.description: Collection of items to which the query applies (`user`, `domain`, `drive`, `allDrives`). Prefer `user` or `drive` over `allDrives`.

parameters.name: corpus
parameters.description: Deprecated: use `corpora` instead.

parameters.name: driveId
parameters.description: ID of the shared drive to search.

parameters.name: includeItemsFromAllDrives
parameters.description: Whether both My Drive and shared drive items should be included.

parameters.name: includeLabels
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of label IDs to include in `labelInfo`.

parameters.name: includePermissionsForView
parameters.description: Additional view's permissions to include. Only `published` is supported.

parameters.name: includeTeamDriveItems
parameters.description: Deprecated: use `includeItemsFromAllDrives` instead.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of sort keys, e.g. `folder,modifiedTime desc,name`.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of files to return (max 1000).

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Token continuing a previous list request.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Query for filtering the file results.

parameters.name: spaces
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of spaces to query (`drive`, `appDataFolder`).

parameters.name: supportsAllDrives
parameters.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives.

parameters.name: supportsTeamDrives
parameters.description: Deprecated: use `supportsAllDrives` instead.

parameters.name: teamDriveId
parameters.description: Deprecated: use `driveId` instead.

get.summary: Get a file's metadata or content by ID
get.description: Gets a file's metadata or content by ID. If `alt=media` is provided, the response includes the file contents in the response body. Downloading content with `alt=media` only works for files stored in Drive; use `files.export` for Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: The ID of the file.

parameters.name: acknowledgeAbuse
parameters.description: Whether the user acknowledges the risk of downloading known malware or other abusive files. Only applicable when `alt=media`.

parameters.name: includeLabels
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of label IDs to include in `labelInfo`.

parameters.name: includePermissionsForView
parameters.description: Additional view's permissions to include. Only `published` is supported.

parameters.name: supportsAllDrives
parameters.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives.

parameters.name: supportsTeamDrives
parameters.description: Deprecated: use `supportsAllDrives` instead.

parameters.name: alt
parameters.description: Data format for the response, or `media` to download file content.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response.

quotaUser.name: quotaUser
quotaUser.description: An arbitrary string tied to a user, for quota purposes.

kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: `"drive#fileList"`.

nextPageToken.description: The page token for the next page of files. Absent if the end of the list has been reached.

incompleteSearch.description: Whether the search process was incomplete (some results may be missing).

File.description: The metadata for a file. Some resource methods (such as `files.update`) require a `fileId`; use `files.list` to retrieve it.

kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: `"drive#file"`.

name.description: The name of the file. Not necessarily unique within a folder.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the file. Auto-detected from uploaded content if not provided. Cannot be changed unless a new revision is uploaded.

description.description: A short description of the file.

starred.description: Whether the user has starred the file.

trashed.description: Whether the file has been trashed, explicitly or via a trashed parent folder.

explicitlyTrashed.description: Whether the file was explicitly trashed (vs. recursively via a parent).

trashedTime.description: The time the item was trashed (RFC 3339). Only populated for shared drive items.

parents.description: The ID of the parent folder. A file can only have one parent; use `addParents`/`removeParents` on update to change it.

properties.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs visible to all apps.

appProperties.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs private to the requesting app.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version number for the file.

webContentLink.description: A link for downloading the content of the file in a browser.

webViewLink.description: A link for opening the file in a relevant Google editor or viewer.

iconLink.description: A static, unauthenticated link to the file's icon.

hasThumbnail.description: Whether this file has a thumbnail.

thumbnailLink.description: A short-lived link to the file's thumbnail, if available.

thumbnailVersion.description: The thumbnail version, for thumbnail cache invalidation.

viewedByMe.description: Whether the file has been viewed by this user.

viewedByMeTime.description: The last time the file was viewed by the user (RFC 3339).

createdTime.description: The time the file was created (RFC 3339).

modifiedTime.description: The last time the file was modified by anyone (RFC 3339). Also updates `modifiedByMeTime` for the user when set.

modifiedByMe.description: Whether the file has been modified by this user.

modifiedByMeTime.description: The last time the file was modified by the user (RFC 3339).

sharedWithMeTime.description: The time the file was shared with the user, if applicable (RFC 3339).

owners.description: The owner of this file. Not populated for items in shared drives.

driveId.description: ID of the shared drive the file resides in.

shared.description: Whether the file has been shared. Not populated for items in shared drives.

ownedByMe.description: Whether the user owns the file. Not populated for items in shared drives.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the current user has on this file.

copyRequiresWriterPermission.description: Whether copy, print, or download should be disabled for readers and commenters.

writersCanShare.description: Whether users with only `writer` permission can modify the file's permissions. Not populated for shared drive items.

permissions.description: The full list of permissions for the file. Only available if the requesting user can share the file; not populated for shared drive items.

permissionIds.description: List of permission IDs for users with access to this file.

hasAugmentedPermissions.description: Whether there are permissions directly on this file. Only populated for items in shared drives.

inheritedPermissionsDisabled.description: Whether this file has inherited permissions disabled.

folderColorRgb.description: Color for a folder or shortcut to a folder as an RGB hex string. Falls back to the closest palette color if unsupported.

originalFilename.description: The original filename of the uploaded content, or the original `name`. Only for files with binary content.

fullFileExtension.description: Full file extension extracted from `name` (may be a concatenation, e.g. "tar.gz"). Only for binary-content files.

md5Checksum.description: The MD5 checksum for the file's content, if applicable.

sha1Checksum.description: The SHA1 checksum for the file's content, if available.

sha256Checksum.description: The SHA256 checksum for the file's content, if available.

size.description: Size in bytes of blobs and Google Workspace editor files. Not populated for files with no size, like shortcuts and folders.

quotaBytesUsed.description: Number of storage quota bytes used by the file.

headRevisionId.description: ID of the file's head revision. Only available for files with binary content.

contentHints.description: Additional information about the file's content. Never populated in responses.

indexableText.description: Text to index to improve fullText queries (max 128 KB).

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the thumbnail.

contentRestrictions.description: Restrictions for accessing the file's content, if any exist.

resourceKey.description: A key needed to access the item via a shared link.

isAppAuthorized.description: Whether the file was created or opened by the requesting app.

exportLinks.description: Links for exporting Docs Editors files to specific formats.

targetId.description: ID of the file this shortcut points to. Settable only on create.

targetMimeType.description: MIME type of the target, snapshotted at shortcut creation time.

imageMediaMetadata.description: Additional metadata about image media, if available.

videoMediaMetadata.description: Additional metadata about video media; may not be available immediately upon upload.

labels.description: Labels on the file as requested via `includeLabels`. Empty by default.

linkShareMetadata.description: Details about the link URLs clients use to refer to this item.

kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: `drive#user`.

displayName.description: A plain text displayable name for this user.

photoLink.description: A link to the user's profile photo, if available.

me.description: Whether this user is the requesting user.

permissionId.description: The user's ID as visible in Permission resources.

emailAddress.description: The email address of the user. May be absent if the user hasn't made it visible to the requester.

Permission.description: A permission for a file. Grants a user, group, domain, or the world access to a file or folder hierarchy.

kind.description: Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: `"drive#permission"`.

type.description: The type of the grantee: `user`, `group`, `domain`, or `anyone`.

emailAddress.description: The email address of the user or group this permission refers to.

domain.description: The domain this permission refers to.

view.description: The view this permission belongs to (`published` or `metadata`), if any.

allowFileDiscovery.description: Whether the file can be discovered through search. Only applicable to `domain` or `anyone` permissions.

displayName.description: The "pretty" name of the value of the permission.

photoLink.description: A link to the user's profile photo, if available.

expirationTime.description: When this permission expires (RFC 3339). Only settable on user and group permissions; must be in the future, within one year.

deleted.description: Whether the account associated with this permission has been deleted. Only for `user` or `group` permissions.

pendingOwner.description: Whether the account associated with this permission is a pending owner. Only for `user` permissions on non-shared-drive files.

inheritedPermissionsDisabled.description: When true, only organizers, owners, and users with direct permissions can access the item.

permissionDetails.description: Details of whether permissions on this item are inherited.

permissionType.description: The permission type for this user: `file` or `member`.

role.description: The primary role for this user.

inheritedFrom.description: ID of the item this permission is inherited from.

ContentRestriction.description: A restriction for accessing the content of the file.

readOnly.description: Whether the file's content is read-only. If true, no new revision, comment, or title change may be made.

reason.description: Reason the content is restricted. Only mutable alongside `readOnly=true`.

restrictionTime.description: When the content restriction was set (RFC 3339). Only if `readOnly=true`.

type.description: The type of restriction. Currently only `globalContentRestriction`.

ownerRestricted.description: Whether only the file owner (or an organizer, for shared drive items) can modify or remove this restriction.

systemRestricted.description: Whether the restriction was applied by the system (e.g. an esignature). Users cannot modify these.

DownloadRestriction.description: A restriction for copy and download of the file.

restrictedForReaders.description: Whether download and copy is restricted for readers.

restrictedForWriters.description: Whether download and copy is restricted for writers. If true, download is also restricted for readers.

DownloadRestrictionsMetadata.description: Download restrictions applied to the file.

itemDownloadRestriction.description: The download restriction applied directly by the owner or organizer. Doesn't account for shared drive settings or DLP rules.

effectiveDownloadRestrictionWithContext.description: The effective download restriction, considering all restriction settings and DLP rules.

Label.description: Representation of label and label fields.

revisionId.description: The revision ID of the label.

fields.description: A map of the fields on the label, keyed by field ID.

LabelField.description: Representation of a field, a typed key-value pair.

id.description: The identifier of this label field.

dateString.description: Only present if `valueType` is `dateString`. RFC 3339 date: YYYY-MM-DD.

ClientEncryptionDetails.description: Details about the client-side encryption applied to the file.

encryptionState.description: The encryption state of the file: `encrypted` or `unencrypted`.

wrappedKey.description: URL-safe Base64 encoded wrapped key used to encrypt the file's contents.

encryptionResourceKeyHash.description: URL-safe Base64 encoded HMAC-SHA256 digest of the resource metadata with its DEK.

kaclsId.description: The ID of the KACLS (Key ACL Service) used to encrypt the file.

kaclsName.description: The name of the KACLS used to encrypt the file.

jwt.description: Signed JWT authorizing the requesting user with the KACLS, asserting at least read access to the file.

keyFormat.description: Key format for the unwrapped key. Must be `tinkAesGcmKey`.

aes256GcmChunkSize.description: Chunk size for AES 256 GCM encrypted content: `default` or `small`.
